entities.name: Wick
entities.description: A legendary ratfolk warlock from Bloomburrow, a psychic who founded a snail cult after going mad.

entities.name: Grotgyre
entities.description: Wick's companion snail, infested by a parasitic worm and become the godlike figure of Wick's cult.

entities.name: Conch
entities.description: The town where Wick grew up.

entities.name: Wick's cult
entities.description: A cult Wick founded around Grotgyre while mad with sickness.

events.summary: Wick bonded with the snail Grotgyre as a young psychic in Conch.
events.quote: In Wick's case, he bonded with a snail named Grotgyre.

events.summary: The town's snails became infested with parasites and grew ill.
events.quote: the town's snails became infested with parasites and grew ill

events.summary: Sickened by proxy, Wick had visions that drove him mad, and he founded a new cult and gathered followers.
events.quote: In his insanity, Wick formed the foundations of a new cult and started gathering followers.

relations.note: Psychic bond with his companion snail.
relations.quote: Wick and Grotgyre possessed a strong connection.
